svg.title: Studio diary: establish a recognizable alternation
svg.desc: Only image x coordinates and complete copy-group x translations in rows 2, 3 and 4 change. Image-side order becomes left, right, left, right instead of left, left, right, left. The first row, all y positions, words, type styles, image dimensions/crops/source pixels, paper and lighting stay fixed. Original fictional editorial diary; alternation is contextual.
